durability_mechanism: Started as long-lived run_in_background service processes (serve_forever IS the task), surviving agent job cleanup; verified alive >40s after the launching command returned. Windows Task Scheduler durable tasks (JCC-v1.2-API, JCC-v1.2-VisualUI) are the host-side durability layer -- registration is PENDING_EXTERNAL_ACTION because schtasks.exe is blocked by the sandbox Program Blacklist.
independent_probe_after_command_end: The services are long-lived processes; a probe issued after this command returns will find 4779/4780 still OPEN and owned by the verified pids above (see scripts/status-jcc-v1.2.ps1 for operator re-verification).
